# S7: P_high from 14 to 20 MPa

Each named design re-solved with P_high from 14 to 20 MPa in 0.25 MPa steps, every other variable fixed (design-point solve: effectiveness 0.90, cooler pinch 5 K). Payout at the baseline M0 = 39.059 t, N = 10. Slopes near the limit are the one-sided differences over the last 0.5 MPa (19.5 -> 20 MPa).
